meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按时间段汇总会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需整理团队会议记录并定期产出摘要
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes into a structured report for a time range
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into reports

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按你给的时间范围查询会议记录，提取每场会议关联的纪要信息，整理成含概览统计与逐会议详情的结构化报告；需要时还能生成飞书文档或追加到已有文档。
howto.when: 当你要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报或回顾某段时间的会议内容时接管；未指定时间范围时默认查过去 7 天。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要
say.note: 默认按本周一到现在的范围汇总

say.text: 回顾过去一周开了哪些会
say.note: 输出周报格式的会议列表

say.text: 把上周的会议纪要汇总成一篇文档
say.note: 会新建或追加到飞书文档

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude searches your meeting records for a given date range, pulls each meeting's note metadata, and builds a structured report with an overview and per-meeting details; it can also create a Lark doc or append to an existing one.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you ask to organize meeting notes, generate a weekly meeting report, or review meetings from a period. Defaults to the past 7 days if no range is given.

say_en.text: Organize this week's meeting notes for me.
Show me which meetings happened in the past week.
Summarize last week's meetings into a document.
say_en.note: Creates or appends to a Lark doc.
